title: Baobab-Platform capability-centric domain identifiers and enumerations
description: Canonical identifiers and enumerations for the capability-centric platform model (ADR-BCP-002 through ADR-BCP-009, ADR-SHARED-007). This package defines vocabulary only; baobab-platform/baobab-cp is the runtime authority that persists, evaluates and resolves these concepts.

capabilityKey.description: Implementation-neutral capability identity in <domain>.<resource>.<action> form, e.g. "commerce.order.create". Must never contain a vendor name (medusa, idempiere, payload, haystack), a tenant name, or a region/country name. The key is stable across provider replacement: moving a capability from one provider to another never renames it.

capabilityDomain.description: Governed top-level namespace for a capability key's first segment. A new top-level domain requires an architecture review and an update to this enum; see namespace-registry.yaml for rationale per domain.

capabilityId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a registered Capability. Never derived from the capability_key.

capabilityDependencyType.description: Whether a depended-upon capability must, may, or conditionally must be satisfied.

capabilityLifecycle.description: Operational lifecycle of a Capability, CapabilityProvider or CapabilityBinding. Distinct from maturity: a capability can be maturity=SUPPORTED and lifecycle=SUSPENDED simultaneously.

capabilityMaturity.description: Confidence/support level of a Capability's contract and implementation. Distinct from lifecycle.

capabilityCompositionType.description: Classification of a CapabilityComposition. Governs how it may be combined with others, not runtime behaviour.

capabilityMembershipCriticality.description: Criticality of one capability's membership within one specific composition. The same capability can be MANDATORY in one composition and OPTIONAL in another.

capabilityScopeId.description: Identifier for a CapabilityScope. Deliberately distinct from mapping.mappingScopeId (contracts/control-plane/v1/domain.schema.json): the two share dimension vocabulary but are not the same object, per ADR-SHARED-007 §25.

capabilityGrantStatus.description: Lifecycle of a CapabilityGrant. A grant is effective only when status=ACTIVE and the current time falls within [effective_from, effective_to).

capabilityGrantSource.description: Provenance of a CapabilityGrant. Multiple independent grants from different sources may coexist for the same tenant/capability/scope; revoking one source does not revoke grants from another.

capabilityProviderType.description: Kind of implementation a CapabilityProvider represents.

providerHealthStatus.description: Ephemeral operational health of a provider or engine instance, distinct from lifecycle. Health is never persisted as a substitute for lifecycle state.

bindingMode.description: Canonical binding mode (locked by BCP-TS-ONBOARDING-001 CR-002, confirmed in baobab-platform/baobab-cp Phase-0 audit against ADR-SHARED-007's own independent proposal of the same five values). PRIMARY: normal authoritative binding. FALLBACK: eligible only under approved failover conditions, never a bypass of entitlement/scope/contract/residency/isolation checks. SHADOW: non-authoritative mirrored execution, never determines the business result. MIGRATION: temporary binding participating in an explicit ProviderMigration plan. DISABLED: retained but excluded from resolution. No other value is valid; a superseded seven-value set (including SECONDARY, READ_ONLY, MIGRATION_SOURCE, MIGRATION_TARGET) existed in early baobab-platform/baobab-cp migrations and must not be reintroduced -- see this schema's own README.md for the rationale.

engineKey.description: Technology family identity, e.g. "medusa", "idempiere", "payload", "haystack". An engine never defines Baobab product identity.

capabilityResolutionDecision.description: Outcome of a capability resolution request.
